public_gates: design an action-sensitive selector over the full M495 matched-current surface
rank rows by wrong-history first-action and short-horizon trajectory distance before outcome gates
preserve source diversity across seeds labels targets configs and offsets
do not train or promote checkpoint
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add privileged actor inputs
do not use hidden-hold variants as deployable proof
do not repeat M496 target-z triage unchanged

hypothesis: An action-sensitive selector can avoid M497's weak wrong-history trajectory signal by selecting natural matched-current rows where wrong-history changes the short-horizon closed-loop action trajectory before current-response correction dominates.
success_criteria: define probe semantics for cheap action or short-horizon wrong-history scoring
define selection metrics and diversity caps
failure_criteria: design relies on hidden-hold as deployable proof
training or checkpoint promotion is proposed

commands.name: selector_design
commands.command: Use M498 audit results to design a natural action-sensitive selector before M500 implementation.

decision_rule: M499 should admit implementation only if the selector uses observed wrong-history action or short-horizon trajectory signal while preserving source-diversity and avoiding hidden-hold proof.
